solvents.name: Activated MDEA (aMDEA)
solvents.composition: 45.0 wt% MDEA + 5.0 wt% Piperazine + 50.0 wt% Demin Water
solvents.purpose: Simultaneous removal of CO2 (< 50 ppmv) and H2S (< 4 ppmv) from high-pressure natural gas
solvents.handlingAndSafety: Mild alkaline, non-flammable, handle with nitrile gloves and safety goggles. Biodegradable.

solvents.name: Triethylene Glycol (TEG)
solvents.purpose: Intermediate dehydration and hydrate prevention during upset scenarios
solvents.handlingAndSafety: Low toxicity, hygroscopic liquid, flash point 177 °C.

adsorbents.name: Molecular Sieve Type 4A
adsorbents.purpose: Ultra-deep gas dehydration down to < 0.1 ppmv H2O to prevent cryogenic ice and hydrate blockages at -162 °C
adsorbents.handlingAndSafety: Inert aluminosilicate ceramic, dust inhalation protection required during loading.

adsorbents.name: Mercury Guard Bed Adsorbent
adsorbents.purpose: Chemisorptive removal of elemental mercury vapor from natural gas down to < 0.01 ug/Nm3 (forms HgS cinnabar) to prevent liquid metal embrittlement of aluminum MCHE brazed fins
adsorbents.handlingAndSafety: Non-regenerable, spent material is classified as stable non-leachable metal sulfide waste.

catalysts.name: Claus Stage 1 Titania-Promoted Catalyst
catalysts.purpose: Converts H2S and SO2 to elemental sulfur while hydrolyzing COS and CS2 at 320 °C

catalysts.name: Claus Stage 2 Standard Activated Alumina Catalyst
catalysts.purpose: High-conversion Claus reaction (2 H2S + SO2 <-> 3 S + 2 H2O) at 220 °C near dew point

catalysts.name: SCOT Tail Gas Hydrogenation Catalyst
catalysts.composition: 3.5 wt% CoO + 13.0 wt% MoO3 on porous Al2O3 support
catalysts.purpose: Catalytic hydrogenation of all unconverted SO2, Sx, COS, and CS2 to H2S at 280 °C with H2 make-up

refrigerants.name: High-Purity Propane (R-290)
refrigerants.purpose: Chills treated feed gas and mixed refrigerant down from +35 °C to -35 °C across 3 pressure stages

refrigerants.name: Mixed Refrigerant (MR) Working Fluid
refrigerants.purpose: Continuous boiling multicomponent refrigerant evaporating from -35 °C to -162 °C inside the Main Cryogenic Heat Exchanger (MCHE)
refrigerants.makeupSourcedFrom: On-site NGL fractionation and Nitrogen ASU

utilityChemicals.name: Sodium Hypochlorite (Electrochlorination)
utilityChemicals.purpose: Prevents marine biofouling (mussels, barnacles, algae) in the 60,000 m3/h seawater intake and ORV tubes

utilityChemicals.name: Diethylhydroxylamine (DEHA) Oxygen Scavenger
utilityChemicals.purpose: Eliminates dissolved oxygen in 45 barg boiler feedwater to prevent pitting in HRSG tubes

utilityChemicals.name: Tetrahydrothiophene (THT) Odorant
utilityChemicals.purpose: Provides standardized warning odor for export natural gas pipeline distribution per ISO 13734
